body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md (v2, builds on SC-001). Do not edit either spec. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add fixtures/v2/catalog.json: about 15 SKUs drawn from the shopper's repeated history items, each with category staple, fresh, or household and a price at keells, cargills, spar, and glomark. Keells price is the latest observed unit price (source receipt, observed_on). Other stores are source fictional within plus or minus 10 percent of the Keells price, so Keells wins some plans and loses others. fixtures/v2/history-map.json maps receipt descriptions to SKU ids.
Add fixtures/v2/offers.json: card offers for Commercial Bank, Nations Trust Bank, and HNB credit across the four stores (bank, product, store_id, days, rate_bps, min_bill_lkr, cap_lkr, include_categories, exclude_categories, valid_to, stackable false) and store promotions (store_id, sku_id or category, rate_bps, days, valid_to). Every row is a labeled demo shape.
Add src/savvycart/pantry.py: pantry(history, catalog, history_map, today) returns, per SKU with purchases on two or more distinct dates, cadence_days (median gap), usual_qty (median quantity), last_bought, next_due, days_left, status, reason. due when days_left <= 3 and the SKU has three or more purchase dates; soon when days_left <= 7 or a two-date SKU would be due; else ok. One purchase date is unknown. The reason string uses only those numbers and dates.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Cadence and status follow the history. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_pantry.py::test_cadence_and_status_follow_history -q
2. Fixtures are labeled and fictional prices stay in band. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_pantry.py::test_v2_fixtures_are_labeled_and_in_band -q
title: Add v2 catalog, offers, and the pantry engine
